unit: NZD lump sum, ex-GST, ex-preliminaries, ex-margin, for the whole 30 kWp array

band.unit: NZD lump sum, ex-GST, ex-preliminaries, ex-margin, for the whole 30 kWp array
band.basis: Sub-total mounting system $5,900-$9,300 (rails/clamps/brackets supply + fixings allowance + installation labour); strengthening $1,300-$2,800 (QV purlins + bolt allowance); structural design & PS1 $3,400-$6,800 (Proconsult rates x assumed hours). Summed, not averaged: $10,617-$18,865, rounded to $10,600-$18,900 (about $353-$630 per kWp). Cross-checked against Nova/NREL 2026 racking hardware of $0.08-$0.15/W, which puts 30 kWp hardware alone at roughly $2,400-$4,500 - consistent with the supply component. Confidence low: the rail brand/spec is not nominated, layout/quantities are assumed, and the fee is hours-based rather than a quote.

Working estimate band (not a certified price), GST exclusive, excluding preliminaries and margin, Auckland, for the fixed scope only: mounting system supply + mounting-only labour + supplementary purlins to one third of footprint + engineer design/PS1. Built from QV CostBuilder rows (purlins t7:r25/r26, bolts t8:r2/r3, labour t0:r27/r31), fetched vendor/consultant pages (mounting hardware source-2, engineer fees source-3) and two minor allowances (fixings/sealant; engineer fee). Component sum: 3,000-10,000 + 3,000-6,000 + 2,100-3,100 + 300-900 + 1,500-4,000 = $9,900-$24,000, midpoint ~$16,950. Band is wide and confidence low because mounting-hardware pricing spans retail-vs-commercial benchmarks and the mounting labour hours are assumed. A reviewer can reject any one component without disturbing the others.

Sum of five separately priced components, all GST-exclusive, Auckland rates: (1) proprietary mounting hardware $2,500-$6,000; (2) mounting installation labour $2,600-$5,600 (QV roofer rate x assumed hours); (3) supplementary purlins $1,200-$2,250 (QV); (4) purlin bolts $330-$770 (QV); (5) structural design + PS1 $1,500-$4,000. Component mid-points sum to approx $13,400. QV publishes no solar/PV mounting rate, so the mounting system - roughly 60% of the total - is a residential aggregate scaled to 60 panels plus a wholesale Clenergy component build-up; the labour hours, purlin quantity and PS1 fee involve QS judgement. Confidence is therefore LOW and the band is deliberately wide. Scope excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, PV modules, inverters, cabling/electrical work, roof sheet replacement/repair/recoating, scaffolding/edge protection/roof access, and consent fees.
